about: Every host check that only observes, reports or runs in shadow, and every rule the rule map marks prose or partly, with the date by which the host decides it: enforce, retired (moved to PLAYBOOK guidance) or extend (once, with a reason). decideBy is at most 14 days after since. The rule map lives in bee-scouts (templates/rule_map.json) and carries no lifecycle yet, so the lifecycles of its prose and partly rules are kept here under rules. Read by scripts/rule_lifecycle.py. Every live step of host-checks.yml runs through scripts/live_gate.py, which reads this file: a check listed here reports its exit 1 until its decideBy (or an extend's), then blocks unless a decision is recorded; a check not listed here is enforced (25 Nov 2026 update, row 41r1).
